claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) describes Akashic access as tuning to information in the Source or ether through frequency, rather than visiting a literal library.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She says the library is one person’s interpretation of the information.

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says answers vary with the seeker’s frequency and beliefs; deep meditation and an emptied mind reduce distortion.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She says shared answers may reflect shared perceptual agreements rather than absolute truth.
